pattern: ようが～ようが / ようと～ようと
aliases: you ga~you ga / you to~you to
purpose: Apply a conclusion across two alternative conditions.
keywords: V volitional + が … V volitional + が; V volitional + と … V volitional + と
We deliver whether it rains or snows.
Whether people agree or oppose it, I will explain fully.
Win or lose, I will run to the end.
formation: V volitional + が … V volitional + が; V volitional + と … V volitional + と
restrictions: The alternatives do not affect the main statement.
mistake: Unlike とも～とも, this affirms a stable conclusion rather than withholding judgment.
